summary: Iteration 61 — Rapid Fire 2.0 three new features + colour redesign. Backend: 5 new pytest tests for /feed, /players/{pid}/h2h, /rush/claim, diamond store (buy ruby/emerald, blocked kohinoor, av_ruby 403 before purchase, diamonds_total), /duels/{id} players[].streak — ALL PASS. Regression test_rf_social.py (3 tests) still green (8/8 total). Frontend: UI tested on the real QA learner (phone 7004186276) after seeding rf_social_fixture: Friend Activity feed renders 3 preview rows → 'See all (8)' toggle → 8 rows (all event kinds show sensible text, no 'undefined'); Aarav profile shows HEAD TO HEAD card ('You 2 – 1 Aarav Sharma', '4 matches played, 1 v 1 only'), tapping See every match opens h2h-sheet with W/L/T form dots, 4 rows, note, tapping a row opens duel-result match review; Diya profile correctly shows 'No 1 v 1 match yet' and no open button; player-wings present inside the card on 390px (no overflow at 320px either); Rewards tab shows Diamond Rush with Bronze/Silver OPEN; Bronze claim marks chest Opened ✓ and backend returns +25 coins BUT the top-strip game-hud-coins HUD stayed at 102 (did not refresh client-side — see bug below); Store Frames tab shows YOUR DIAMONDS panel and Ruby Blaze/Sapphire Halo/Emerald Aura/Kohinoor Crown with diamond price buttons, Ruby Blaze purchase sheet confirms with 'Buy with diamonds' and completes. Colour redesign: blood-red stage, dark cherry cards, gold titles, no leftover navy/blue — looks correct in every tab screenshot. No React Native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues spotted in the scoped files.

ui_bugs.issue: After claiming Bronze (rf-rush-claim-1) the backend awards +25 coins (confirmed by rush_claim 200 and pytest coverage), the chest shows 'Opened ✓', but the top-strip game-hud-coins text stays at 102 both before and after the claim. The HUD (coin pill) is not refreshed from the claim response on the client. Need to merge rush/claim.coins_total into the profile store or invalidate the HUD query.

action_items: Fix game-hud-coins not refreshing after /rf/rush/claim. RushTrack returns new coins_total in the response — propagate it into whatever hook feeds arena-top profile/coins (same place that updates after shop buy).

(Optional hardening) /app/backend/social.py:96 team_line() crashes with KeyError when a duel has team_mode=True but no 'teams' field. Prod seeder never does this, but a `d.get('teams') or {}` guard would be safer for forward-compat.
critical_code_review_comments: Social.stats_of caches by uid for 30 s without invalidation on new duels — not blocking but can make freshly finished matches lag in the h2h counts UI.

rca_of_issue: HUD coin refresh after Rush claim: screenshots 10_rewards_rush.png and 11_bronze_claimed.png both show '102' in game-hud-coins while the chest itself transitions from OPEN → Opened ✓. Backend POST /api/rf/rush/claim returns {coins, coins_total, rush}; RushTrack.tsx likely consumes the response locally for the chest state only and doesn't push coins_total back into the arena HUD store (compare with /shop/buy which updates coins correctly). Fix: in the onSuccess of the rush claim mutation, call the same setter/invalidator used by /shop/buy (e.g. profile query refresh or wallet store merge of coins_total).
